title: associate facts
description: The hand-back a model reports: facts, the alternatives it weighed, the verdicts it reached and the items it left open, beside an optional free-text summary. A source is an optional run label and a walk id (for example w12 or run-3:w12), never a path. Cross-field rules (a verdict's basis names facts of this payload, a supported or refuted verdict has no unread items, an open item names its deciding check, an action fact names its tool) are checked by the hand-back checker, not here.

summary.description: Free text; never a checked answer.

action.description: True when the fact states that an action happened (a tool ran, a file changed, a test passed, a record was stored).

tool.description: For an action fact: the tool whose call the fact says happened. The cited entry must be a call of this tool that did not end in an error or refusal.

predicts.description: What would be seen if this alternative held.

basis.description: Ids of the facts this verdict rests on.

unread.description: What was not read that bears on this verdict.

check.description: For open or cannot_tell: the check that would decide it.

closing.description: Marks the closing conclusion of the hand-back; when no verdict is marked, the last verdict is the closing one.

check.description: The check that would decide it; an open item without one is refused by the checker.
